import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import h5py
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import ttest_rel
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
import statsmodels.api as sm

# Define region codes for groups
# Based on standard MEG layout: occipital roughly regions 17-19, 25-26; auditory (temporal) ~ regions 07-12
OCC_CODES = {'17','18','19','25','26'}
AUD_CODES = {'07','08','09','10','11','12'}

meg_files = [f"sub-0_ses-{i}_meg.h5" for i in range(1, 11)]
event_files = [f"sub-0_ses-{i}_events.tsv" for i in range(1, 11)]
pre_t = 0.2  # s
pos_t = 0.5  # s

epoch_occ = []
epoch_aud = []
event_ids = []

for ses_idx, (meg_path, evt_path) in enumerate(zip(meg_files, event_files), start=1):
    # Load MEG data
    with h5py.File(meg_path, 'r') as f:
        data = f['data'][:]                # (306, n_times)
        times = f['times'][:]
        sf = f.attrs['sample_frequency']
        ch_names = [ch.strip() for ch in f.attrs['channel_names'].split(',')]
    n_times = data.shape[1]

    # Identify channels by region code
    occ_idx = [i for i,ch in enumerate(ch_names) if ch[3:5] in OCC_CODES]
    aud_idx = [i for i,ch in enumerate(ch_names) if ch[3:5] in AUD_CODES]
    if not occ_idx or not aud_idx:
        continue

    # Load events and select word onsets
    ev = pd.read_csv(evt_path, sep='\t')
    words = ev[(ev.kind=='word') & (ev.timesentence==0)]

    for idx, row in words.iterrows():
        t0 = row.timemeg
        i_pre = int((t0 - pre_t) * sf)
        i0    = int(t0 * sf)
        i_post= int((t0 + pos_t) * sf)
        if i_pre<0 or i_post>n_times:
            continue
        var_pre  = np.var(data[:, i_pre:i0], axis=1)
        var_post = np.var(data[:, i0:i_post], axis=1)
        dv = var_post - var_pre
        epoch_occ.append(dv[occ_idx].mean())
        epoch_aud.append(dv[aud_idx].mean())
        event_ids.append(f's{ses_idx}_e{idx}')

occ = np.array(epoch_occ)
aud = np.array(epoch_aud)
n_epochs = len(occ)
print(f"Epochs: {n_epochs}")

# Paired t-test
t_stat, p_val = ttest_rel(occ, aud, nan_policy='omit')
print(f"t = {t_stat:.3f}, p = {p_val:.3e}")

# Boxplot
plt.figure(figsize=(6,4))
plt.boxplot([occ,aud], tick_labels=['Occipital','Auditory'], notch=True)
plt.ylabel('Variance change')
plt.title('Variance Change at Word Onsets')
plt.show()

# Mixed-effects model
df = pd.DataFrame({
    'var': np.concatenate([occ,aud]),
    'group': ['occ']*n_epochs + ['aud']*n_epochs,
    'event': event_ids+event_ids
})
md = smf.mixedlm('var ~ group', df, groups=df['event'])
res = md.fit(reml=False)
print(res.summary())

# List sensors
print('Occipital sensors:', [ch for ch in ch_names if ch[3:5] in OCC_CODES])
print('Auditory sensors:',  [ch for ch in ch_names if ch[3:5] in AUD_CODES])

pre_t = 0.2  # s
pos_t = 0.5  # s

epoch_occ = []
epoch_aud = []
event_ids = []

for ses_idx, (meg_path, evt_path) in enumerate(zip(meg_files, event_files), start=1):
    # Load MEG data
    with h5py.File(meg_path, 'r') as f:
        data = f['data'][:]                # (306, n_times)
        times = f['times'][:]
        sf = f.attrs['sample_frequency']
        ch_names = [ch.strip() for ch in f.attrs['channel_names'].split(',')]
    n_times = data.shape[1]

    # Identify channels by region code
    occ_idx = [i for i,ch in enumerate(ch_names) if ch[3:5] in OCC_CODES]
    aud_idx = [i for i,ch in enumerate(ch_names) if ch[3:5] in AUD_CODES]
    if not occ_idx or not aud_idx:
        continue

    # Load events and select word onsets
    ev = pd.read_csv(evt_path, sep='\t')
    words = ev[(ev.kind=='word') & (ev.timesentence==0)]

    for idx, row in words.iterrows():
        t0 = row.timemeg
        i_pre = int((t0 - pre_t) * sf)
        i0    = int(t0 * sf)
        i_post= int((t0 + pos_t) * sf)
        if i_pre<0 or i_post>n_times:
            continue
        var_pre  = np.var(data[:, i_pre:i0], axis=1)
        var_post = np.var(data[:, i0:i_post], axis=1)
        dv = var_post - var_pre
        epoch_occ.append(dv[occ_idx].mean())
        epoch_aud.append(dv[aud_idx].mean())
        event_ids.append(f's{ses_idx}_e{idx}')

occ = np.array(epoch_occ)
aud = np.array(epoch_aud)
n_epochs = len(occ)
print(f"Epochs: {n_epochs}")

print(f"t = {t_stat:.3f}, p = {p_val:.3e}")

# Boxplot
plt.figure(figsize=(6,4))
plt.boxplot([occ,aud], tick_labels=['Occipital','Auditory'], notch=True)
plt.ylabel('Variance change')
plt.title('Variance Change at Word Onsets')
plt.show()

# Mixed-effects model
df = pd.DataFrame({
    'var': np.concatenate([occ,aud]),
    'group': ['occ']*n_epochs + ['aud']*n_epochs,
    'event': event_ids+event_ids
})
md = smf.mixedlm('var ~ group', df, groups=df['event'])
res = md.fit(reml=False)

print('Auditory sensors:',  [ch for ch in ch_names if ch[3:5] in AUD_CODES])
